notes:
V3.1.0 — Wave 5: multi-account, in-place friend profile, credits + admin, bot-market rebrand.

MULTI-ACCOUNT (no more re-login)
• New file apex_accounts.json keeps the last 20 signed-in tokens. Sign-in/sign-up auto-saves to this list.
• Login screen shows a CONTINUE AS section with every saved account — one click signs you in without typing a password.
• User chip dropdown lists every other saved account for instant switching, plus 'Add account' to add new ones.

IN-PLACE FRIEND PROFILE
• Clicking 👁 View on a friend now swaps the whole FRIENDS tab to a full profile view (no more popup) — header card with name + tier, four MetricCards (broker / daily / monthly / yearly P&L matching the overview style), and a BOTS SHARED section listing every bot the friend has published and consented to share. Each row has a ⬇ Install button that downloads + registers the bot in your local library.

CREDITS LEDGER
• New /credits/me endpoint + a credits chip in the header showing your live balance.
• Server tables: user_credits (cached balance) + credit_transactions (audit log) with all grants signed by an admin.
• 1 credit = $0.01 by convention (the API doesn't know about real money yet — that's wave 7).

ADMIN HIERARCHY
• New role column on users with values USER / ADMIN / SUB_BOSS_ADMIN / BOSS_ADMIN. First active user on the server is auto-promoted to BOSS_ADMIN on startup.
• New ♛ ADMIN corner tab — hidden for normal users, visible only when /auth/me returns a non-USER role.
• Admin dashboard: list every user with their credit balance, grant or debit credits (any admin), assign roles (BOSS_ADMIN only).

BOT MARKET REBRAND
• 'MORE BOTS' renamed to 'BOT MARKET' in the tab bar.
• Marketplace rows gain price_credits / philosophy / win_rate_pct / rating / featured / recommended / visibility / active_users columns.
• New endpoints: GET /bots/v2 with filters (philosophy, max_price, min_win_rate, section, sort), GET /bots/mine (publisher analytics), PUT /bots/{slug} (owner-only meta edit), PUT /admin/bots/{slug}/classify (feature/recommend), GET /bots/philosophies.
